youtube_metadata.title: OpenAI Agents Generate Navier-Stokes Millennium Problem Proof #Shorts
youtube_metadata.description:
OpenAI deployed a swarm of 10,000 reasoning agents over 88 hours to formulate a finite-time singularity blowup proof for 3D Navier-Stokes equations, formalized in Lean 4.
